description: Find electronics and their live prices across a market's shops (Lebanon by default in USD; the Gulf, Jordan and Egypt via `market`, in local currency; re-checked nightly). Returns up to 10 products, most widely sold first, each with its lowest price, how many shops sell it, and its page. Laptops also carry model_page: every CPU/GPU variant of that model with the same RAM/storage, which can start lower.

market.description: Optional market: LB (Lebanon, default), AE (UAE), SA (Saudi Arabia), QA (Qatar), JO (Jordan), OM (Oman), EG (Egypt), KW (Kuwait) or BH (Bahrain). Prices come back in that market's currency.

max_price.description: Optional upper price limit, in the market's currency.

max_price_usd.description: Optional upper price limit in USD (converted for non-USD markets).

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'macbook air m4', 'rtx 5070 laptop', 'iphone 17 256gb'.

name: search_products
title: Search LebTech / PriceTeq
